_how: Developer visual inspection of the numbered contact sheets (random sample of up to 48 extra boxes per clip and profile: boxes of confirmed person tracks that the Standard profile does not have on the shared 2-fps frames). Categories: footballer = a player or goalkeeper in kit on the pitch; other_person = a real person who is not a footballer on the pitch (spectator, coach, staff, photographer, interviewee); fragment = a box on part of a player that another box already covers; not_person = object, board, text, ball, blur; uncertain = cannot be decided at this resolution. NOT manually labelled ground truth (no complete frames were labelled); recall is not measured.
